Goku.role: Orchestrator and default executor. Plans backlog work, owns the app target (document windows, editor, status bar, menus, settings, preview, voice), integrates worker output, verifies the Test build and commits.

Yamcha.role: Syntax worker. Owns Packages/QuickEditSyntax: vendored tree-sitter grammars and queries, the vendoring script, language registry and highlighter API, with Swift Testing coverage; updates its own backlog tasks.

Piccolo.role: Core worker. Owns the UI-free QuickEditCore modules assigned to it (text format detection, .editorconfig, risky characters, property lists) with Swift Testing coverage, in its own worktree; updates its own backlog tasks.

Krillin.role: Visual asset worker. Designs and builds the app icon procedurally (Icon Composer .icon + actool) and owns scripts/make-icon.swift and Resources/AppIcon.icon.

Gohan.role: Extension worker. Implements assigned app-extension and packaging tasks (Quick Look preview extension, build-script steps for it), verifies them without opening Quick Look panels, and hands changes to Goku for integration.

Bulma.role: Researcher and reviewer. Investigates unclear requirements, reviews diffs for bugs and security issues, and returns findings to Goku for recording.
